reason: I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and my waiters know how to use them. A second QR system with its own payment fee on top means more staff training and more to reconcile at closing, and three free months doesn't change that.
objection: Why should I run two systems and pay a second transaction fee when my POS and terminal already take the money? Most of my guests are happy to hand the waiter a card.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into Wox, so the bill and the payment show up in my POS without staff doing anything twice, and a restaurant like mine showed me it brought regulars back.
